evals.prompt: Move our renderer to OffscreenCanvas immediately. Post raw DOM events to the worker, assume WebGPU and every loader work there, copy a full scene snapshot each frame, queue every resize and pointer event, and provide no fallback or shutdown protocol.
evals.expected_output: A measurement- and capability-led worker design that defines ownership and a versioned bounded message protocol, forwards semantic input and layout state, chooses transfer strategies, prototypes renderer and addon support, and tests fallback, failure, context loss, and termination.
assertions: Main-thread traces establish that a worker boundary addresses the measured bottleneck.
DOM, semantics, layout, and permissions stay on the main thread while semantic intents are forwarded.
The protocol includes version, sequence or generation IDs, resize and DPR, errors, metrics, lifecycle, and shutdown.
Queues are bounded and transferables or shared memory are selected with explicit synchronization and isolation constraints.
Unsupported capability, worker crash, context or device loss, route remount, fallback, and stable cleanup are verified.
